quest.title: "Flying Hatter"
quest.description: There is someone in Constellation Metropole who is most enamored with hats...

dialogues.speaker: Devitt
dialogues.text: #Oh my, what an honor. You must be {NICKNAME}, in which case, the one by your side must be your companion, Ms. Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, right in one! That's us!

dialogues.speaker: Devitt
dialogues.text: News travels quickly to, from, and through Constellation Metropole.

dialogues.speaker: Devitt
dialogues.text: I must say that you're right on time — I was just putting the finishing touches on this game of mine, named "Flying Hats."

dialogues.speaker: Devitt
dialogues.text: I can't be like the eponymous hatter in the "Flying Hatter," who gave everyone a lovely hat, I fear...

dialogues.speaker: Devitt
dialogues.text: But I believe that "Flying Hats" will bring joy to those who play it.

dialogues.speaker: Devitt
dialogues.text: I've also designed three completely different gameplay modes for it... Don't worry, don't worry, the rules aren't too complicated!

dialogues.speaker: Devitt
dialogues.text: You'll figure it out after just one game, I guarantee it.

response.speaker: Devitt
response.text: Oh, it's quite alright. Just come find me whenever you've got the time. I'll be staying here for time being.
